meta.name: seo-audit
meta.description: Full website SEO audit with parallel subagent delegation. Crawls up to 500 pages, detects business type, delegates to up to 15 specialists (8 always + 7 conditional), generates health score. Use when user says audit, full SEO check, analyze my site, or website health check.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对网站进行完整SEO审计并生成健康评分
copy.tagline_en: Run a full SEO audit on your website and get a health score.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a comprehensive SEO audit with actionable recommendations.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能对网站进行完整 SEO 审计：爬取最多 500 个页面，检测业务类型，调用最多 15 个专家子代理分析技术、内容、性能等，并生成健康评分和优先行动方案。
howto.when: 当你提到“审计”、“SEO 检查”、“分析我的网站”或“网站健康检查”等关键词时，Claude 会触发该技能。

say.note: Claude 会开始爬取并生成完整 SEO 报告。

say.text: 对 example.com 做一次全面的 SEO 检查。
say.note: 触发完整审计流程，包括所有子代理。

say.text: 检查 example.com 的网站健康状态。
say.note: Claude 会输出健康评分和关键问题。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can perform a full SEO audit of a website: crawl up to 500 pages, detect business type, delegate to up to 15 specialist subagents for technical, content, performance analysis, etc., and generate a health score with prioritized action plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "audit", "SEO check", "analyze my site", or "website health check".

say_en.note: Claude will start crawling and generate a full SEO report.

say_en.text: Run a comprehensive SEO check on example.com.
say_en.note: Triggers the full audit process including all subagents.

say_en.text: Check the health status of example.com.
say_en.note: Claude will output a health score and key issues.
